name: Race for the Galaxy

categories.label: Victory point chips
categories.hint: Total value of VP chips earned (Consume phase and powers).

categories.label: Printed VP on tableau cards
categories.labelVi: Điểm in trên bài trong bàn
categories.hint: Sum of VP printed on worlds and developments in your tableau (excluding 6-cost developments' variable VP).

categories.label: 6-cost development bonus VP
categories.hint: End-of-game VP from each 6-cost development, per its card text.

categories.label: Cards in hand + goods on worlds (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Bài trên tay + hàng trên hành tinh (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Counted after discarding at end of final round.

tiebreakers.description: Most cards in hand plus goods on worlds
If still tied, all tied players win.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends at the end of the round in which a player has 12+ tableau cards or the last VP chip is taken. Final: tableau VP + VP chips + 6-cost development VP. Expansions (Gathering Storm, Brink of War, etc.) add prestige/goals not modelled. Printed 6-cost values are on component cards (scorer input).
